architecture: Peri-RMS + XSA + SwiGLU + per-head Q/K RMS + scaling after output RMS + tied embedding/readout + parameter-free RMS including embedding + causal attention centering.

intended_equation: For query i (zero-based), C_ij=A_ij-1/(i+1) if j<=i, else 0. Compute y_i=sum_j C_ij*v_j; then existing clipped XSA projection of y_i along own v_i; then original output projection, RMS and 1/sqrt(2L) residual coefficient.
numerical_evaluation: Subtract a shared anchor from values in both weighted and uniform averages; zero row sum makes the anchor cancel. This is distinct from the existing centered-XSA algebraic rearrangement.
causal_adaptation: Use the visible prefix mean, including the current value, in dense, chunked and shared-prefix cached execution. The full-sequence uniform matrix from the papers would expose future values in this GPT. No extra trainable parameters or change to learned initial matrices.
hypotheses: Removing the uniform token-mixing component may preserve distinctions and improve first-99 learning. XSA already suppresses a different component (the own-value direction), so the combined effect must be measured.
theory_scope: Prove zero row sums, annihilation of constant value signals and the centering identity with explicit causal support. Existing Peri-RMS hidden-state bounds still apply to arbitrary raw branches. The papers' asymptotic unmasked random-initialization spectral results do not establish absence of rank collapse, bounded full-network gradients or faster grokking for this causal trained model. The causal uniform-prefix matrix is lower triangular and generally full rank, not the papers' global rank-one uniform matrix; row-sum-zero alone is not a spectral-gap theorem.

screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
parent_comparison: Preserve all 18 pairs against peri-rms-scaled-lr2 to isolate attention centering; screen gate still uses LR x2.
full_suite_policy: Evaluate all 75 paired short cells for every candidate that advances. Prefer complete coverage, then lower full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Compare against both original baseline and LR x2; include all per-task medians/worst cases, slower seeds and censoring. If no candidate improves on LR x2, retain the incumbent and report the negative results.
long_policy: Wait for this newly requested candidate too before final short selection. Complete all currently running fixed candidates; do not use long outcomes for tuning. A new final winner receives one reused 30-cell long diagnostic.
invariants: Unchanged frozen model sources, task manifest, data, seeds, batch order, dimensions, dtype, warmup, weight decay, evaluation cadence and update budgets; separately archived code/configuration for every new output directory.
staging_policy: Develop outside the recursively hashed scientific source trees while the preceding two full suites run. Integrate only after their frozen execution has finished, then test and freeze a fresh output plan. Older runs replay from their archived sources/9e57d7e.
